LESSON: INDICES AND LOGARITHMS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers 1.2 Cubes and Cube Roots (5 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand the l
Topic 1.3: Indices and Logarithms
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Indices and Logarithms, part of Numbers 1.2 Cubes and Cube Roots (5 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand the l in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we express numbers in powers?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Indices and Logarithms together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: as learner shows the laws of indices using multiplication and division.

• Self-efficacy: as learner discusses and relates powers of 10 to common logarithms

Values:
• Responsibility: as learner takes the roles in turns to lead the teams in discussions on indices.

• Unity: as learner measures capacity in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Learner relates self-awareness to his/her own ideas as he/she discusses concept of Indices.

Link to other subjects:

Learner expresses numbers as indices and powers as used in Integrated Science.
